cues.text: Open Inventory in the sidebar and choose Assignments. It shows who currently holds which item.
Choose the item, the person and the quantity. Add a note, such as a serial number or the purpose.
Press Assign. The item is dated today, and its stock goes down.
When an item comes back, press Return on its row, choose its condition and confirm. The stock is restored.
Open the Returned tab to see items that came back, with the date and condition. You can also search by person or item.
